capability.name: AID endpoint proof check (PKA, RFC 9421 Ed25519)
capability.description: Checks the endpoint proof of AID v2.1.1 Appendix B for an exchange you made: the key k from the _agent record, the request you sent (URI, nonce, AID-Domain) and the response you got (status, Signature-Input, Signature, Cache-Control). Applies every verifier rule: covered components, tag, alg, keyid as the RFC 7638 thumbprint of k, nonce, the 300-second window and freshness, no-store, no redirect, domain binding (B.7), and Ed25519 over the rebuilt RFC 9421 signature base. Returns each check with its reason and the exact signature base, which is what a signer's author needs when a proof fails.

k.description: the key from the record (unpadded base64url)

record.description: instead of k: the TXT string that has k

request.description: {uri, nonce, method (default GET), aid_domain (the AID-Domain header, if you sent one)}

now.description: unix seconds when the response arrived

skew.description: allowed clock difference in seconds, 0 to 300

note: tells a client whether an agent endpoint proved the key its domain publishes
